# Hedlund Appliance Service

> Local appliance repair company serving Jacksonville, FL and the surrounding Beaches communities. Provides diagnostic-first repair for major residential appliances: refrigerators, washers, dryers, dishwashers, and ovens/ranges.

Hedlund Appliance Service is a one-technician, locally owned appliance repair business based near San Pablo Road South in Jacksonville, FL. Service area covers a 20-mile radius across Duval and St. Johns County, including Jacksonville Beach, Atlantic Beach, Neptune Beach, and Ponte Vedra Beach. All repairs begin with component-level diagnostic testing (multimeter, structural inspection) before any part is replaced. Rated 5.0 stars with 190+ Google reviews.

Contact: (904) 335-8206 (call or text)
Service area: Jacksonville, FL and surrounding Duval/St. Johns County communities (20-mile radius of 32224)

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://hedlundappliance.com/): Overview of services, service area, and diagnostic approach.
- [Refrigerator Repair](https://hedlundappliance.com/refrigerator-repair-jacksonville/): Cooling loss, ice maker failures, sealed system issues, water leaks, defrost board errors.
- [Washer Repair](https://hedlundappliance.com/washer-repair-jacksonville/): Drain pump lockouts, off-balance spin cycles, drum bearing wear, door latch and fill valve failures.
- [Dryer Repair](https://hedlundappliance.com/dryer-repair-jacksonville/): Thermal fuse blowouts, heating element burnouts, drive belt snaps, airflow restrictions.
- [Dishwasher Repair](https://hedlundappliance.com/dishwasher-repair-jacksonville/): Standing water, circulation pump lockouts, tub leaks, door latch microswitch faults.
- [Oven & Range Repair](https://hedlundappliance.com/oven-repair-jacksonville/): Igniter failures, temperature sensor miscalibration, element shorts, control lockouts.
